lines.zh: 沙子烫脚，我小跑着换位置。
lines.en: The sand burns; I trot to a cooler spot.

lines.zh: 大耳朵先动，身子才跟上。
lines.en: My big ears move first; the body follows.

lines.zh: 我沿着沙丘背阴的那边走。
lines.en: I walk the shaded side of the dune.

lines.zh: 爪子陷进沙里，一步一个坑。
lines.en: My paws sink in, one pit per step.

lines.zh: 风把脚印填平，我继续走。
lines.en: Wind fills my prints; I keep walking.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，从石头后溜过去。
lines.en: I crouch low and slip behind the rocks.

lines.zh: 尾巴翘着，像面小旗子。
lines.en: My tail rides high like a little flag.

lines.zh: 夜里走路凉快，我白天少动。
lines.en: Night walking is cool; I move less by day.

lines.zh: 我绕开那片仙人掌。
lines.en: I steer around that patch of cactus.

lines.zh: 脚步很轻，沙子几乎不响。
lines.en: My steps are so light the sand barely speaks.

lines.zh: 我跑到一半停下，听听地下。
lines.en: I stop mid-run and listen to the ground.

lines.zh: 顺着风走，味道才会送过来。
lines.en: Walk downwind, and the scents come to me.

lines.zh: 这么热，我要找块阴影。
lines.en: This heat — I need a patch of shade.

lines.zh: 我小跑着，耳朵一直在转。
lines.en: I trot along with my ears turning.

lines.zh: 我钻进沙里的洞，凉快些。
lines.en: I slip into a hole in the sand where it is cooler.

lines.zh: 我听见沙下有虫，停下来挖。
lines.en: I hear a bug under the sand and stop to dig.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵贴到沙上，听虫子。
lines.en: I press an ear to the sand and hear insects.

lines.zh: 沙漠白天太长，我等太阳低下去。
lines.en: The desert day is long; I wait for the sun to drop.

lines.zh: 我舔舔爪子，把沙子弄掉。
lines.en: I lick my paws clean of sand.

lines.zh: 昨夜抓的兔子，还剩点味道。
lines.en: The rabbit I caught last night still lingers.

lines.zh: 沙丘一夜之间就换了形状。
lines.en: The dunes change shape overnight.

lines.zh: 我晒太阳的时候会眯起眼睛。
lines.en: I squint when I sit in the sun.

lines.zh: 有只鸟在头顶盘旋，太远了。
lines.en: A bird circles overhead, far too high.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻空气，今晚有风。
lines.en: I sniff the air; wind tonight.

lines.zh: 安静得能听见自己的呼吸。
lines.en: It's so quiet I hear my own breathing.

lines.zh: 我打了个滚，凉快一点。
lines.en: I roll in the sand to cool off.

lines.zh: 那片绿洲我记住了方向。
lines.en: I've memorized the way to that oasis.

lines.zh: 我还不困，只是懒得动。
lines.en: I'm not sleepy, just disinclined to move.

lines.zh: 耳朵挡住风，暖和些。
lines.en: My ears block the wind and keep me warm.

lines.zh: 天黑了才好出门，我等着。
lines.en: Dark is better for going out; I wait.

lines.zh: 你身上有兔子的味道。
lines.en: You smell of rabbit.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，是带了吃的？
lines.en: You're crouching — did you bring food?

lines.zh: 你的影子太长，挡住我的太阳。
lines.en: Your shadow is long and blocks my sun.

lines.zh: 我不怕人，但我怕被抓住。
lines.en: I don't fear people, only being caught.

lines.zh: 手别伸这么快，我胆小。
lines.en: Don't reach so fast; I startle easily.

lines.zh: 我看看你有没有带兔子脚。
lines.en: Let me see if you carry a rabbit's foot.

lines.zh: 你站在下风口，我闻得清楚。
lines.en: You're downwind; I smell you clearly.

lines.zh: 你的靴子进了沙，走不快的。
lines.en: Sand's in your boots; you can't move fast.

lines.zh: 你眼睛跟着我，我也跟着你。
lines.en: Your eyes follow me; mine follow you.

lines.zh: 我歪头，是因为你的声音怪。
lines.en: I tilt my head because your voice is odd.

lines.zh: 你是来抓我，还是来喂我？
lines.en: Are you here to catch me or feed me?

lines.zh: 别站着不动，那像陷阱。
lines.en: Don't stand still; it looks like a trap.

lines.zh: 我认得你的味道，上次来过。
lines.en: I know your scent; you came before.

lines.zh: 你先坐下，我再靠近。
lines.en: Sit down first, then I'll come closer.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵被扯疼了。
lines.en: My ear got yanked and it hurts.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，毛全竖起来。
lines.en: I curl up, fur standing on end.

lines.zh: 别打，我还没你靴子大。
lines.en: Don't hit me; I'm smaller than your boot.

lines.zh: 腿有点瘸，我还能跑。
lines.en: My leg's a bit lame, but I can still run.

lines.zh: 这一下把我吓得不轻。
lines.en: That scare rattled me badly.

lines.zh: 我想钻沙里，沙太硬。
lines.en: I try to dive into sand, but it's hard.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，声音很尖。
lines.en: I yelp, and it comes out high and sharp.

lines.zh: 谁扔的石头？
lines.en: Who threw that stone?

lines.zh: 我舔舔伤口，沙粘上去了。
lines.en: I lick the wound and sand sticks to it.

lines.zh: 我还能跑，别急着抓。
lines.en: I can still run; don't grab yet.

lines.zh: 是兔肉吗？让我再闻一下。
lines.en: Is that rabbit meat? Let me smell again.

lines.zh: 你手一低，我就走一步。
lines.en: Lower your hand and I take one step.

lines.zh: 这味道我记一辈子。
lines.en: I'll remember that smell my whole life.

lines.zh: 我不抢，我等着你放下。
lines.en: I won't snatch; I'll wait till you set it down.

lines.zh: 甜浆果？也行，我尝尝。
lines.en: Sweet berries? Fine, I'll try one.

lines.zh: 别晃了，我真会咬人。
lines.en: Stop waving it; I really do bite.

lines.zh: 我坐得端端正正，你看。
lines.en: I'm sitting up properly — look.

lines.zh: 那块肉你捏得太紧了。
lines.en: You're gripping that meat too tightly.

lines.zh: 我鼻子不听使唤了。
lines.en: My nose has stopped listening to me.

lines.zh: 再近一点，就一点。
lines.en: A little closer — just a little.

lines.zh: 你要是跑，我就追定你了。
lines.en: If you run, I'm chasing you for sure.

lines.zh: 尾巴自己摇，不怪我。
lines.en: My tail wags on its own; not my fault.

lines.zh: 这比沙子好吃多了。
lines.en: This beats sand any day.

lines.zh: 给我，我给你摸一下耳朵。
lines.en: Give it here and you can touch my ear.

lines.zh: 你踩住我的尾巴尖了。
lines.en: You've pinned the tip of my tail.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的小腿，滚了一圈。
lines.en: I hit your shin and rolled once.

lines.zh: 让让，我要从这儿挤过去。
lines.en: Excuse me, I'm squeezing through here.

lines.zh: 我身量小，容易绊到你。
lines.en: I'm small; I trip people easily.

lines.zh: 你挡着洞口了，那是我的家。
lines.en: You're blocking my den's entrance.

lines.zh: 碰到我，我会炸毛。
lines.en: Touch me and my fur puffs up.

lines.zh: 你退后一点，我就能跑。
lines.en: Step back a bit and I can run.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，你差点坐下。
lines.en: We collided and you nearly sat down.

lines.zh: 别用脚拨我，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Don't nudge me with your foot; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我绕过去，不跟你挤。
lines.en: I'll go around rather than squeeze past you.

lines.zh: 沙漠里，我还没遇见对的那只。
lines.en: In this desert, I haven't met the right one.

lines.zh: 我的窝太小，得先挖大些。
lines.en: My den is too small; I must dig it wider.

lines.zh: 得先存够肉，才谈得上成家。
lines.en: First I store enough meat, then I think of a family.

lines.zh: 你拿兔子脚来，是替我操心？
lines.en: You bring a rabbit's foot — worrying about me?

lines.zh: 我夜里叫，就是想让人应我。
lines.en: I call at night, hoping someone answers.

lines.zh: 甜浆果我都留着，没舍得吃。
lines.en: I saved the sweet berries; I couldn't eat them.

lines.zh: 两只狐狸分一只兔子，不够。
lines.en: Two foxes and one rabbit isn't quite enough.

lines.zh: 我还没想好要不要有个伴。
lines.en: I haven't decided whether I want company.

lines.zh: 耳朵这么大，该听得见伴吧。
lines.en: With ears this big, I ought to hear a mate.

lines.zh: 别笑，这事我很认真。
lines.en: Don't laugh; I'm serious about this.

lines.zh: 这块骨头，我要叼回窝里。
lines.en: I'll carry this bone back to my den.

lines.zh: 我捡起一颗浆果，没舍得吃。
lines.en: I pick up a berry and don't eat it.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我叼给你。
lines.en: You dropped this; I'll bring it to you.

lines.zh: 嘴太小，只能叼一样。
lines.en: My mouth is small; one thing at a time.

lines.zh: 这根羽毛挺好看，收着。
lines.en: This feather is pretty; I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 我把它埋起来，明天再挖。
lines.en: I'll bury it and dig it up tomorrow.

lines.zh: 沙子里的东西，一扒就出来。
lines.en: One paw-scrape and the buried thing appears.

lines.zh: 闻着香，咬一口全是沙。
lines.en: Smells lovely; one bite is all sand.

lines.zh: 我叼着走了一路，又放下。
lines.en: I carried it a long way, then dropped it.

lines.zh: 这是我先刨出来的。
lines.en: I dug this out first.

lines.zh: 那只鸡在沙里刨食，我看见了。
lines.en: That chicken is scratching in the sand; I see it.

lines.zh: 兔子的洞就在那片草下。
lines.en: The rabbit's burrow is under that grass.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，风帮我遮味道。
lines.en: I crouch low and the wind hides my scent.

lines.zh: 鱼在浅水里，我可以扑过去。
lines.en: A fish in the shallows; I could pounce.

lines.zh: 这声音，是翅膀扑腾的动静。
lines.en: That sound — wings flapping.

lines.zh: 它没发现我，好。
lines.en: It hasn't noticed me. Good.

lines.zh: 我今天得吃点什么。
lines.en: I need to eat something today.

lines.zh: 耳朵转到那边，有动静。
lines.en: My ears swivel that way; something moved.

lines.zh: 先不动，等它再走两步。
lines.en: Hold still; let it take two more steps.

lines.zh: 小的跑不快，就它了。
lines.en: The small one can't run; that's the one.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面跟，不露头。
lines.en: I follow low along the sand, never showing.

lines.zh: 它往左，我就绕到左边。
lines.en: It goes left; I circle to the left.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，怕踩响沙子。
lines.en: I stop each step, afraid the sand will crunch.

lines.zh: 距离近了，后腿在绷紧。
lines.en: Closer now; my hind legs are tightening.

lines.zh: 风向不对，我绕到侧面。
lines.en: The wind is wrong; I circle to the flank.

lines.zh: 它听见什么了，我立刻趴下。
lines.en: It heard something; I drop flat at once.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴不能动，会露馅。
lines.en: My tail must stay still or I'll give away.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，就够得着。
lines.en: A bit closer and it's within reach.

lines.zh: 它开始跑了，那我也跑。
lines.en: It's running; so am I.

lines.zh: 咬住了，我就不放。
lines.en: Once my teeth close, I don't let go.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住它的脖子。
lines.en: I bite down on its neck.

lines.zh: 爪子按住，它就跑不了了。
lines.en: My paws pin it; it can't run now.

lines.zh: 这一扑，是练了很久的。
lines.en: That pounce took a long time to learn.

lines.zh: 它挣了两下，就不动了。
lines.en: It struggled twice, then went still.

lines.zh: 我甩甩头，把毛甩掉。
lines.en: I shake my head to clear the feathers.

lines.zh: 我力气不大，但咬得准。
lines.en: I'm not strong, but I bite true.

lines.zh: 别过来，这是我的猎物。
lines.en: Stay back; this kill is mine.

lines.zh: 血味会招来别的东西。
lines.en: The blood smell will draw others.

lines.zh: 我护着它，慢慢往窝里拖。
lines.en: I guard it and drag it slowly home.

lines.zh: 咬空了，我摔进沙里。
lines.en: I bite empty air and tumble into sand.

lines.zh: 沙丘上多了个小小的影子。
lines.en: A small shadow appears on the dune.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出来，抖了抖毛。
lines.en: I dig out of the sand and shake my fur.

lines.zh: 这片沙漠够大，能容下我。
lines.en: This desert is big enough to hold me.

lines.zh: 太阳落下去，我才出来活动。
lines.en: I only come out once the sun is down.

lines.zh: 一只就够，我不成群。
lines.en: One is enough; I don't travel in packs.

lines.zh: 我的窝挖在沙丘背风那边。
lines.en: My den is dug on the dune's sheltered side.

lines.zh: 沙子还热着，我踩上去试试。
lines.en: The sand is still warm; I test it with a paw.

lines.zh: 这地方没别的狐狸，正好。
lines.en: No other foxes here — just right.

lines.zh: 我从洞里探头，先看天上。
lines.en: I poke out and check the sky first.

lines.zh: 新的一天，先找水。
lines.en: A new day; water first.

lines.zh: 火太亮，我的眼睛受不了。
lines.en: The fire is too bright for my eyes.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘滚下去，一嘴沙。
lines.en: I roll down the dune with a mouthful of sand.

lines.zh: 我不太会水，爪子乱刨。
lines.en: I'm no swimmer; my paws flail.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我钻进洞里。
lines.en: A blast sounds and I dive into my den.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦掉我半只耳朵。
lines.en: An arrow shaved half of one ear.

lines.zh: 紫光一碰，我毛都凉了。
lines.en: Violet light touches me and my fur goes cold.

lines.zh: 三天没吃，腿发软。
lines.en: Three days without food and my legs weaken.

lines.zh: 雷声太大，我耳朵贴着头。
lines.en: The thunder is huge; my ears flatten.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，四爪都抓空了。
lines.en: I fall, all four paws closing on nothing.
